requirement: The start screen gives way once anything is sent, a bare /help is only the questions, and the Copy box is one row

oracle.ref: PR #1031 (fix); fix evidence: 08/10/2026, from screenshots of the dev machine: the Edit / Comments / Site changes / Team list stayed after /help, a bare /help repeated what the chat box hint says, and the Copy box was too tall and too wordy. Evidence: tasks/bang-chung/lan-5-man-chao-va-copy/.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0'; the named cases are 'ok': nothing sent keeps the start screen; a sent count above 0 ends it; a Help question or a bare /help ends it after a reload; the one-time tip does not; a bare /help has no greeting sentence in the dictionary or the row; a Copy box is a flex row with the button beside the text and long lines scrolling sideways; one 8px gap separates two blocks of an answer; the Help strip has no max-height. S3: after each of the four sends the title and the four cards (Edit, Comments, Site changes, Team) are gone and the chat box stays at the bottom of the column; a bare /help shows the four suggested questions and the Discord link and no 'Hi, I'm Tracy' sentence; a one-line sample request in a Copy box stays one line, with the Copy button at its right and no empty line under the text.
